description: This PHP file defines the 'Manufacturer' controller class for the OpenCart admin panel, including methods for listing, creating, editing, enabling, disabling, deleting, and providing autocomplete for manufacturers.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Controller class managing manufacturer-related administrative functions such as listing, editing, and deleting manufacturers within the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point displaying the manufacturer list and setup of page data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Dispatches to get the manufacturer list view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and renders a list of manufacturers with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Prepares and displays the manufacturer creation/edit form.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving new or updated manufacturer data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected manufacturers from the database.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides manufacturer suggestions for autocomplete fields.
